title: Hex Color Palette
summary: Drive the mood and aesthetic of the image using a list of hex codes. Useful for brand consistency, editorial shoots, or locking a specific vibe. Default palette is editorial neutrals; swap the hex list in the prompt for any brand palette.
prompt: Create an image that is pure vibes, think like Editorial, cars, 2000s ads, you can use some colors from this palette #07130e, #556659, #b9b5d0, #f3f1e6, #dedbc9, #afaa92, #ffffff
